record.reason: Looped Actor shares policy computation and adaptively exits for RL decisions. Full text covers 22 tasks and reports fewer inference FLOPs than an Iso-FLOPs fixed-depth baseline; fixed variants with fewer than 16 loops lose performance. This is embodied/RL adaptive computation rather than LLM inference; authors note the policy is not guaranteed compute-optimal.
record.title: Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning
